depicted_variant: Sawaki Suushi 1737 Hyakkai Zukan thin aged dream spirit with cane and fading lower body
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Square mature painterly mythology encyclopedia artwork. YUME NO SEIREI, Japanese dream spirit following Sawaki Suushi's 1737 Hyakkai Zukan depiction. One VERY THIN elderly human-shaped man with gaunt normal human face, sparse long wispy grey-white hair drifting gently, ordinary human eyes, coherent normal arms and hands. Loose plain WHITE robe falls open only modestly at upper chest to reveal an emaciated rib outline, rest of body covered. His left hand holds a simple wooden CANE; right hand raised in a gentle beckoning gesture. His lower robe/body distinctly dissolves gradually into pale grey mist with no visible feet, no severing or injury. Dark quiet old Japanese bedroom suggested with empty sleeping mat and timber wall; ominous dreamlike stillness. No horns, claws, teeth enlargement, animal traits, extra limbs, glowing eyes, gore, exposed genitals or other figures. Elegant detailed atmospheric brushwork, deep forest-green shadows and restrained antique-gold illumination, main head and hands contained in frame. No writing, signature, watermark, border, gore or unintended extra limbs.
